description: Estimate actual noise around potential homes.
notes: Coded against the Kit contract with a guarded inline fallback shim (window.Kit || ...); the real shared/kit.js landed mid-build and takes precedence — all 10 verified against the real kit: zero console/page errors, core interactions clicked, 1280x800 shot captured.

notes.note: Noise is the #1 post-move regret and listings will never disclose it — the wedge is real. Weakest assumption: modeled dB-by-hour is trustworthy enough to bet a lease on; if the model is wrong once, trust is gone. The Zillow licensing story is the business; the consumer tool is the demo.
Quietest-8h window finder highlights chart; listing cards toggle on-chart, zero errors.

notes.change: Quietest-8h result now renders inline under the chart (the #qw strip was always empty) with per-apt peak caveats; added Copy-verdict button on the head-to-head. u7->8.
